allowed_change_only: primary_dimension and prefix_dimensions chosen from physical sector dimension before results
algorithm: one explicit U-Arnoldi chain per coordinate; retain matching UQ and HQ; all prefixes share actions

numerical_rules.prefix_stability_reference: primary versus largest available lower prefix; H2 4 vs 2, H4/H6 8 vs 4
numerical_rules.numerical_threshold_origin: normalization, orthogonality, breakdown and ambiguity tolerances are floating-point integrity rules; 0.05 full residual limits are predeclared empirical feasibility limits, not spectral certificates

phase_rule: unit-circle projection of projected U eigenvalues followed by full-action residual recalculation; phase lifted to nearest lowest H Ritz energy
branch_ties: descending H-reference overlap, descending previous projector overlap, ascending abs(lifted energy-Href), ascending projected index; overlap ambiguity still abstains
time_continuity: ascending three fixed times within each system; previous selected vector from inherited analyze_coordinate only; no cross-system continuity
breakdown: If actual rank < requested primary, keep failure primary_dimension_unavailable and abstain. Diagnostic lower prefix must not become an accepted lower primary.
rank_exhaustion_at_requested_primary: not a failure solely because H2 primary equals sector dimension; apply inherited numerical/branch gates
action_semantics: build_arnoldi_chain calls apply_u and apply_h once per basis vector. Prefix eigensolutions and residuals use cached UQ/HQ, not additional PF/H calls.
predictor_full_space_solver_policy: no full H/PF truth eigensolver or full PF materialization; projected solve is allowed even when H2 m=4 equals d_sector, labeled finite-sector limit not hidden exact-state input
